title: How It Works
subtitle: A clear, guided transition to AI empowerment.

steps.title: The Audit & Mapping
steps.desc: We sit down with your teams to map out the current flow of data, identifying manual bottlenecks, hidden archives, and fragmented workflows.

steps.title: The Clearing Integration
steps.desc: We build secure RAG channels and design custom LangGraph agent flows. The system is layered on top of your existing tools without down-time.

steps.title: Continuous Nourishment
steps.desc: We monitor agent paths, optimize prompt routing, and train your staff. The network matures, expanding its efficiency week-over-week.
